definitions.explanation: The activity or sport of riding horses. Also used to refer to equestrian activities in general.

examples.japanese: {乗馬|じょうば}を{習|なら}っている。
{週末|しゅうまつ}に{乗馬|じょうば}クラブに{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I go to a riding club on weekends.

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}で{初|はじ}めて{乗馬|じょうば}{体験|たいけん}をしたが、{馬|うま}の{背中|せなか}は{思|おも}ったより{高|たか}くて{怖|こわ}かった。
examples.english: I tried horse riding for the first time in Hokkaido, and the horse's back was higher and scarier than I expected.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both for casual recreational riding and competitive equestrian sports. Can function as a verbal noun with する: {乗馬|じょうば}する (to ride a horse). Also used as a modifier: {乗馬|じょうば}クラブ (riding club), {乗馬|じょうば}{体験|たいけん} (riding experience).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乗馬|じょうば}クラブ (riding club)
- {乗馬|じょうば}{体験|たいけん} (horse riding experience)
- {乗馬|じょうば}する (to ride a horse)
- {乗馬|じょうば}{教室|きょうしつ} (riding school)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {騎馬|きば}: horseback, mounted — more historical/military
- {馬術|ばじゅつ}: horsemanship, equestrian art — competitive/technical term
